name: browser-use
headline: Obsidian Clipper Template Creator - Create JSON
short_description: Creates importable JSON templates for the Obsidian Web Clipper. Helps operations teams standardize note-taking workflows. Integrates with AI agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. Streamlines web clipping into Obsidian.
author: GuppyTheCat

sections.overview:
Obsidian Clipper Template Creator is an AI agent skill that automates template generation for the Obsidian Web Clipper. It analyzes web pages to extract metadata, CSS selectors, and Schema.org data, then maps that content to your existing Obsidian Base schemas to produce valid JSON templates. The skill supports template logic including conditionals, loops, and fallbacks aligned with Obsidian Web Clipper 1.0.0. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and other AI coding assistants, helping operations teams and individual users standardize their web clipping workflows without manual template coding.
Create templates for clipping YouTube videos into Obsidian with consistent metadata
Generate recipe site templates to capture ingredients, instructions, and prep times
Build article clipping templates that extract author, date, and content automatically
Standardize web clipping workflows across teams with reusable JSON templates
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/GuppyTheCat/obsidian-clipper-template-creator`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
